text:
ben_infra: hey team :wave: opening a quota/project approval request for a short benchmarking run in asia-southeast1 (project: redwood-asia-staging). need temporary increases and network limits unblocked before we can run load tests.

ben_infra: request details:
- GPUs: 8 x L4 (n1-standard style), 4 x H100 (for perf parity test)
- TPU quota: none for this run, just GPUs
- External IPs: 6 static eips for test VMs
- VPC peering: establish peering to partner-project: partner-silo-prod for model pull and artifact staging
- Network: increase egress quota to 10 Gbps for 48 hours
- Duration: 2 weeks (start tomorrow, short-lived)
- Billing owner: infra-bench@redwood.com (billing project: redwood-bench-billing)

ben_infra: submitting via GCP support ticket but wanted a quick sync here for approvals and to surface any network/security blockers. low-risk, non-prod.

alice_prod: linking the jira after ticket is created pls, include evaluation prompt set and expected token volumes. also tag compliance for VPC peering approval.

carla_prod: we need a firewall rule to allow artifacts pull on 443 from partner cluster — please add the intended CIDR blocks and source tags. also confirm the subnet secondary IP ranges for pod egress so NAT quotas don't block us.

ben_infra: planned CIDRs: 10.40.0.0/20 (our staging), partner will share theirs. firewall rule name proposed: allow-artifact-pull-staging. adding that to the support ticket.

dan_network: quick heads up — besides External IP quota you may also need more Forwarding Rules and Cloud NAT ephemeral ports. For 6 static eips we should request: 6 Forwarding Rule quota and bump Cloud NAT ephemeral port range to 64k.

ben_infra: good catch. requested in ticket: 6 forwarding-rules, Cloud NAT ephemeral ports -> 65536.

devops-bot: [auto] project redwood-asia-staging - preflight check: billing account linked? NO. org policy: vpc-peering_requires_approval: true. missing IAM role: compute.networkAdmin for ben_infra.

ben_infra: thanks bot. just linked billing account and granted compute.networkAdmin to myself for the ticket duration. updated support ticket number: 1234567890. adding the jira ticket now: RINFRA-5043.

alice_prod: please include expected cost estimate for the 2-week run (GPUs + egress). we need signoff from finance if > $25k.

ben_infra: rough numbers: L4 on gcp asia-southeast1 ~ $0.90/hr -> 8 * 0.9 * 24 * 14 ≈ $2419. H100 ~ $6/hr -> 4 * 6 * 24 *14 ≈ $8064. egress estimate (10TB at 0.12/GB) ~ $1228. total ~ $11.7k. under finance threshold. adding breakdown to RINFRA-5043.

carla_prod: thanks. also add a rollback plan: automatic shutdown at end of window + terraform state lock verification.

ben_infra: rollback plan added: terraform destroy with no confirm; cleanup script /scripts/bench-cleanup.sh; cloud-ops will run at window end.

sre-lead: quick note from SRE — can we restrict H100 instances to a single zone (asia-southeast1-a) to limit blast radius? also put canary traffic through dedicated fetch tier. otherwise :+1:.

ben_infra: will pin H100s to asia-southeast1-a and L4s spread across a/b for throughput. updating ticket.

devops-bot: [auto] support ticket 1234567890 updated: quota request submitted to GCP. estimated processing time ~ 48-72 hours.

alice_prod: once approved, tag me and I’ll push the benchmark configs to the repo and kick off a dry run.

dan_network: one more — add a request for increased VPC route table limit if peering creates more routes. sometimes peering with partner infra adds ~200 routes. request Route limit bump to 1000.

ben_infra: added Route limit -> 1000. documented everything in RINFRA-5043 and attached the gcloud snippet we’ll use for ephemeral VM creation:```bash
gcloud compute instances create bench-vm --zone=asia-southeast1-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=type=nvidia-l4,count=1 --image-family=ubuntu-2004-lts --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
```

alice_prod: looks good. please also paste the exact quota numbers you asked for (GCE GPUs L4: 8, H100: 4, External IPs: 6, Forwarding Rules: 6, Routes: 1000, NAT ports: 65536, Egress Gbps: 10). that helps the GCP reviewer.

ben_infra: pasted exact quotas in ticket. final checklist in ticket: billing linked, IAM granted, firewall rule drafted, rollback plan, cost estimate, jira linked.

devops-bot: [auto] support ticket 1234567890 status: PENDING_APPROVAL by GCP - case#CA-987654. ETA: 72 hours.

sre-lead: approving from SRE side for 2-week window. please include me on escalation channel during run.

ben_infra: thanks all. will report back when GCP approves or if they ask for subnet IDs/peering details. :thumbsup:

carla_prod: also note — if GCP denies H100 quota we fall back to an extra L4 cluster with model parallelism (not ideal but workable).

ben_infra: noted fallback. end of thread.
